title: Page 324
transc:
Baltimore Jan. 7 / 65
Geo D. Sheldon 
Ft Monroe Va.
Baptism Imogene plunder for paradise Are see Webster
sheaf vinton zodiac the baltic got off for
animal before I could counter manned the order
given from grapes to send her there zebra
she had better coal there and return to
Annapolis where she can take whinny zodiac it
is impossible for her the come up here
let me know what orders you give her
princess yoke are M new port . pandora vincent 
J. W. Sampson


Monroe Jan 9 / 65
Maj. Eckert Washington
Fanny for Bologna unity I have wreathed tooth Brutus for
leave to publish my wick of the hannibal affair zodiac
I have received no answer zebra He is absent ditto
In his absence I respect fully ask your leave to
publish it unity It is but justice zodiac Please answer
by wrangle yoke Knave All is well that ends well.
Geo. D. Sheldon
